label: Coroflot
terms_note: Design jobs + portfolios; apply with the Coroflot profile.

endpoints.call: keep — assist for apply; the FeedBurner AllJobs RSS (text/xml) is a usable public feed
endpoints.notes: from the docs / live response read on 2026-09-05

reference.limits: Not published on the pages opened. No developer API; the site links a FeedBurner RSS of all jobs (/rss itself is an HTML page). Terms: security rules forbid unauthorised access / probing; no explicit scraping clause surfaced. robots.txt blocks CCBot, ChatGPT-User, Bytespider, Amazonbot, Applebot-Extended … with Disallow: / for unlisted agents.

search.note: Coroflot's all-jobs RSS 2.0 feed (FeedBurner, latest 30 design jobs). query is not sent (the feed documents no search parameter) - filter the returned postings client-side; the feed answers its whole current list in one response, so ignore next_page (page 2 is the same list). title is '<Company> is seeking a <Role>'; the item description is only the job location, so it is mapped to location. id is the posting link.

not_offered.me: No credentials to verify ('auth: none'): the feed is public and has no account endpoint.
not_offered.get_posting: The feed has no per-item endpoint (each posting's url is an HTML page); search returns the whole record in raw.
not_offered.apply: No application endpoint: the feed only lists postings; candidates apply on each posting's url (employer page / e-mail).
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API; the only machine-readable interface is the public job feed.

live_check.notes: fixed (TypeScript runtime): CDATA titles kept a trailing space in TypeScript only; also: next_page now null (no page parameter); all read tools answered, schema-valid
